mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals a deep recession that triggers aggressive monetary policy and fiscal stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (measured as the 3-month change) and rise in unemployment rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where both GDP declines and unemployment rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%), monetary policy tightening is expected, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL index at 217.541 (2009-12) implies annual inflation of ~1.18%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (measured as the 3-month change) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 550 thousand units, it signals a weak housing market that triggers policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (HOUST<550), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%) and persistently high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth falls below 130000 thousand persons, it signals a weak labor market that triggers policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (PAYEMS<130000), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
